name: Floppy Bunko 14 - Sadistic Gamers Syndrome - Episode 1
original_name: フロッピー文庫14 サディスティックゲーマーズシンドローム エピソード1
source:
You play as a boy who is getting real bad grades. You get a tutor in the form of a strict looking woman who is secretly into some vaguely kinky stuff. She thinks that smart people are sexy, so if you show her how smart you really are, then maybe the game will start to get sexual. The quiz will cover all sorts of topics, though none of the questions are presented in a way that makes it particularly funny. 

[From [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc88/766497-sadistic-gamers-part-1-kateikyoushi-play/reviews/157488]gamefaqs review[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个成绩很差的男孩。你的导师是一位看上去很严格的女人，但她却暗地里喜欢一些有点古怪的东西。她认为聪明的人很性感，所以如果你向她展示你到底有多聪明，那么也许这个游戏就会开始变得性感。测验将涵盖各种主题，但没有一个问题以使其特别有趣的方式提出。

[来自[url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc88/766497-sadistic-gamers-part-1-kateikyoushi-play/reviews/157488]gamefaqs评论[/url]]
